description: This file defines the GraphTransformObserver class used for tracking and visualizing graph transformations within torch.fx, including hooks for node creation, erasure, replacement, and deep copying, as well as methods for applying passes and managing graph visualization.

classes.name: GraphTransformObserver
classes.description: A class for observing, tracking, and visualizing transformations applied to a torch.fx GraphModule, including hooks for node creation, erasure, replacement, and deep copying, as well as methods for applying graph passes and managing visualization output.

methods.name: get_current_pass_count
methods.description: Returns the current count of passes performed by the observer.

methods.name: apply_gm_pass
methods.description: Applies a transformation pass to the GraphModule within the observer's context.

methods.name: apply_graph_pass
methods.description: Applies a transformation pass to the graph within the GraphModule.

methods.name: _check_disable_pass
methods.description: Checks whether a pass should be disabled based on the subsystem configuration.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enters the context, registering hooks and initializing tracking structures.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Exits the context, unregistering hooks and saving visualization graphs if changes occurred.

methods.name: get_node_creation_hook
methods.description: Returns a hook function to track node creation events.

methods.name: get_node_erase_hook
methods.description: Returns a hook function to track node erasure events.

methods.name: get_node_replace_hook
methods.description: Returns a hook function to track node replacement events.

methods.name: get_deepcopy_hook
methods.description: Returns a hook function to track deep copy events of graph modules.
